headline: Short-Term Rentals: AIGAB Responds to Federalberghi and Appeals to the Government: "Raising Taxes Harms Families"
summary: AIGAB and Federalberghi are in a sharp dispute over short-term rentals. AIGAB president Celani disputes the data and urges the Ministry not to raise taxes on the sector.
why: Short-term rentals compete with hotels and affect housing supply and local tourism revenues. Tax changes in this segment shape the profitability of platforms and property owners.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Affitti brevi, AIGAB risponde a Federalberghi e si appella al Governo: "Aumentare le tasse danneggia le famiglie"
